name: Procurement - Awarded Contracts & Amendments
attribution: Office of the Chief Procurement Officer

columns.name: Contract Number
columns.description: number assigned to a contract by the Office of the Chief Procurement Officer; the same contract number applies to amendments of the contract

columns.name: Vendor Number
columns.description: unique number assigned to vendor doing business with Cook County

columns.name: Vendor Name
columns.description: name of vendor who has been awarded the contract

columns.name: Amount
columns.description: amount agreed to be paid by the County for the contract or amendment; may be blank in cases of a revenue generating contract or an amendment which is just an extension/renewal

columns.name: Description
columns.description: description of the project or service the contract covers

columns.name: System Release
columns.description: date when the record is released from procurement system

columns.name: Lead Department
columns.description: department that is sponsoring or lead point on the contract/amendment.

columns.name: Start Date
columns.description: start date of contract/amendment; may be “N/A” or blank when it is a one-time purchase or an amendment increase with no time extension

columns.name: End Date
columns.description: end date of contract/amendment; may be “N/A” or blank when it is a one-time purchase or an amendment increase with no time extension

columns.name: Category
columns.description: indicates whether the record is a new contract or an amendment to an existing contract and opens a link to a PDF of the contract/amendment document

columns.name: Board Approval
columns.description: indicates whether approval from the Board of Commissioners was required to award the contract or amendment

columns.name: Commodity Type
columns.description: broad category of work, goods, or services provided by the contract or amendment
